scope: Only Flash qwen4exp CUDA tiered-cache grouped prefill. No weight, quantization, router, attention/KV, arithmetic order or checkpoint payload changes. Qwen27 uses its existing path.
hypothesis: Bounded async reads of exact selected expert misses overlap SSD service with GPU copies/compute without changing weights or arithmetic.
